home.story.label: Kasbah3000 vision, mission and values
home.vision.title: A desirable, low-impact way of life rooted in place
home.vision.body: Kasbah3000 envisions a multigenerational ecological settlement rooted in Morocco’s landscapes and know-how. We aim to show that low-impact, comfortable and supportive living can address climate challenges while creating lasting opportunities for local communities.
home.mission.title: Turn the village into an open-air laboratory
home.mission.body: Our mission is to bring residents, researchers, craftspeople, farmers and entrepreneurs together around a pilot site. Renewable energy, responsible water management, local food, bioclimatic architecture and participatory governance are designed as one connected ecosystem.
home.values.title: Living systems, learning and cooperation
home.values.body: We are guided by respect for life, learning across generations, cooperation and practical experimentation. Every choice should strengthen shared autonomy, inclusion and the project’s ability to be adapted elsewhere in Morocco.

project.hero.title: The Kasbah3000 project
project.hero.description: A territorial demonstrator for new ways of living in Morocco.
project.hero.imageAlt: Desert horizon and low kasbah silhouette at dawn
project.intro.title: Connecting ancestral knowledge with tomorrow’s needs
project.intro.body: Kasbah3000 is a multigenerational ecological settlement designed as both a place to live and a reproducible demonstrator. It brings together bioclimatic architecture, progressive autonomy, local production and open governance to improve quality of life for the long term.
project.challenges.title: Pressures that reinforce one another
project.challenges.item1.title: Protecting increasingly scarce water
project.challenges.item1.body: Water stress demands lower consumption, protection of local resources and better use of water at every stage.
project.challenges.item2.title: Living with a hotter climate
project.challenges.item2.body: Rising temperatures and energy dependence undermine comfort, household budgets and territorial resilience.
project.challenges.item3.title: Rebuilding connections and prospects
project.challenges.item3.body: Youth migration, limited nearby services and isolation weaken communities and the local economy.
project.solutions.title: Systems designed to work together
project.solutions.item1.title: Circular water management
project.solutions.item1.body: Efficiency, collection, reuse and agroecology form a coherent cycle that reduces withdrawals and restores soils.
project.solutions.item2.title: Efficient, productive architecture
project.solutions.item2.body: Bioclimatic design, appropriate materials and solar generation lower demand while maintaining lasting comfort.
project.solutions.item3.title: A shared local economy
project.solutions.item3.body: Common spaces, a fabrication workshop, useful activities and open governance enable every generation to contribute.
project.goals.title: Prove it today, share it tomorrow
project.goals.5y.title: Establish and measure the model
project.goals.5y.item1: Build the demonstrator’s first homes and essential infrastructure.
project.goals.5y.item2: Measure reductions in water and energy needs alongside improvements in quality of life.
project.goals.5y.item3: Create useful activities and jobs, then document the methods that prove effective.
project.goals.20y.title: Share and replicate
project.goals.20y.item1: Make Kasbah3000 a living reference for regenerative settlement in Morocco.
project.goals.20y.item2: Enable other communities to adapt and reproduce the documented solutions.
project.goals.20y.item3: Strengthen the ecological, social and economic resilience of territories for the long term.
project.timeline.title: Progress through verifiable stages
project.timeline.phase1.title: Studies and community
project.timeline.phase1.description: Territorial assessment, site selection, consultation and detailed design of the model.
project.timeline.phase2.title: Prototype
project.timeline.phase2.description: Construction of the first homes and essential infrastructure, followed by performance monitoring.
project.timeline.phase3.title: Development
project.timeline.phase3.description: Gradual resident onboarding, expansion of local activities and open sharing of lessons learned.

principles.hero.title: The principles of Kasbah3000
principles.hero.description: Twelve complementary systems for living, producing and deciding within the limits of the natural world.
principles.intro.title: An ecosystem designed as a whole
principles.intro.body: Each principle meets an essential need while strengthening the others. Together, they create a framework for living that is efficient, resilient and deeply rooted in its place.
principles.cta.title: Let’s build a regenerative future, one principle at a time.
